At.description: A requested version selector; resolved responses contain a `Revision` instead.

oneOf.description: Resolve the current accepted workspace head exactly once.
Read an explicitly identified historical snapshot.

ExtractionFilter.description:
A filter over sources by extraction.

One variant on purpose: a defaulted `bool` would split the one wire shape, and `Option<bool>`
would have a third state with no meaning.

oneOf.description:
Sources whose converter status is `partial`, `failed` or `unsupported`, whether or not
text was supplied for them.

PageRequest.description: A bounded page request; the cursor is opaque and scoped to the query.

limit.description: Maximum results requested; server may return fewer.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable application identity for one user-organized workspace.

description:
Search the workspace at one revision with explicit scope and pagination.

`query` may be empty (or only whitespace) only when `extraction` is set: then every
matching source under `folder` is a hit, ordered by path, with its description as snippet
(`check_rules`).

at.description: Requested revision selector; latest is resolved once before reading.

extraction.description: Only sources that match; with an empty query, every such source is a hit.

include_archived.description: Include archived items; deprecated items are always searchable.

page.description: Bounded pagination with an opaque cursor.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose permissions and storage scope apply.

title: SearchRequest
